research.title: Support Request Classification: Preprocessing and Evaluation
bullets: Implemented assigned text cleaning and label validation routines for support requests, following existing preprocessing specifications and predefined dataset splits.
Ran the provided classification pipeline and grouped misclassified requests by label pair for review of ambiguous wording and overlapping categories.

projects.title: Product Review Sentiment Classification Baseline
bullets: Implemented a sentiment classification baseline using term frequency–inverse document frequency features and logistic regression in scikit-learn.
Compared predictions against a majority class baseline and inspected errors involving negation, mixed sentiment, and short reviews.
